title: Sharp symmetry bounds for real plane algebraic curves (Theorem 1)
summary: Let C be an infinite real plane algebraic curve defined by a polynomial of degree d >= 2 that is irreducible over the complex numbers, and suppose C is not a circle. Its group of Euclidean symmetries is finite, the orientation-preserving part is cyclic of order at most max(d, 2d - 4), and the full group has order at most 2d. Both bounds are attained in every degree d >= 2.
